requirements.assertion: Each anchor is an own property with the same name.
The anchor value is exposed as $value.
Each tag is exposed with a leading dollar sign.
An unspecialized wrapper serializes as $.
valueOf, toString and toP21String preserve integer semantics.
valueOf, toString and toP21String preserve real semantics and a decimal point.
Decoded value and ISO string literal serialization are exposed.
T and F map to booleans and other symbols map to strings.
The binary literal body and quoted representation are exposed.
The entity name and caller-supplied entity encoding are exposed.
The value name and caller-supplied value encoding are exposed.
The constant entity name and caller-supplied entity encoding are exposed.
The constant value name and caller-supplied value encoding are exposed.
The Part 21 null value maps to ECMAScript null.
valueOf, toString and toP21String return one-dimensional mapped arrays.
URI text, Part 21 delimiters and caller-supplied resolution are exposed.
The exchange-structure address is returned as P21.URI.
FILE_NAME.name is returned as P21.String.
Schema-population entries and their uri, stamp and verification methods are returned.
The exchange-structure address is replaced from P21.URI.
FILE_NAME.name is replaced from P21.String.
The population array and population uri, stamp and verification mutations are applied.
